The American people need relief, and it's time to reverse course on the Biden Admin’s hostility to American energy production.

The bipartisan Telehealth Benefit Expansion for Workers Act expands Americans' access to employer-sponsored health benefits by allowing employers to offer standalone telehealth coverage. To allow continuity of service, we must pass this bill soon!

With several colleagues on both sides of the aisle, I have introduced the bipartisan Telehealth Benefit Expansion for Workers Act, legislation that would expand access to telehealth services by classifying them as an excepted benefit for employer-sponsored coverage.

The digital divide is a matter of economic opportunity, healthcare access, and education. We must act decisively to get all Americans connected.

Check out my op-ed on closing the digital divide in @WashTimes 👇👇

https://t.co/6rkwOg0xla

Recently toured the Berlin Township Wastewater Treatment Plant. They are preparing to undergo necessary repairs and improvements to better equip the plant for water treatment, and I was proud to help them secure funds to get this important project in the works. https://t.co/jrVWcHzWzF

The closure of Palisades will cost Southwest Michigan $250+ million annually.

Visited the Maurice Spears detention and treatment facility in Lenawee County with Mike Hirst, the founder of  Andy’s Angels. We discussed strategies to support drug prevention, recovery, and treatment.

Mike has turned tragedy into positive change in our community. https://t.co/2C5vlQhRUV

Instead of working together to bring down health care costs and increase transparency, the Biden admin’s Association Health Plans (AHP) rule hurts workers and small businesses.
 
AHPs level the playing field for small businesses by allowing high-quality coverage at better rates.

When a person is sick or injured, he or she should have the choice to see the health care provider that best fits his or her needs.  

Glad to see the @EdWorkforceCmte advance my bipartisan legislation to increase choice and access to care.

President Biden often says he's committed to lowering health care costs for hardworking Americans, but his regulatory agenda tells a different story.

Association Health Plans level the playing field for small businesses and reduce health care costs for employees.

Association health plans can provide comprehensive health care options and lower costs for small businesses, leveling the playing field as they compete with larger companies.

We should remove barriers for small businesses and their employees, not create more.

While in effect, the AHP rule produced average savings of 29% and helped small businesses compete.

The disastrous Biden-Harris effort to kill this rule drives up costs and denies many Americans opportunities for more affordable & better coverage options.

We must support AHPs.

In 2024, there were over 80,000 drug overdose deaths in the U.S. @HouseGOP passed the SUPPORT for Patients and Communities Reauthorization Act to fight this crisis and equip communities with the resources necessary to prevent overdoses and counter substance use disorders. We’ll continue to work to address this epidemic.
